text: Our path. What the genetic material is, how it copies itself and how it makes a protein. Mendel's laws, worked through with Punnett squares and the chi square test. Then everything beyond Mendel: blood groups, sex determination, sex linkage and pedigrees. Linkage and crossing over, with gene maps. And mutation and polyploidy.
